presentation_differences: All nineteen named signs are retained; the four sign groups are derived by the definition rather than supplied as group confirmations.
logic_differences: Age is required and absent optional vital signs receive documented normal defaults instead of JavaScript NaN behavior.
unresolved_clinical_ambiguities: A qualified emergency clinician must approve the sign groupings, age-specific vital thresholds, pain escalation, priority labels, time targets, actions, monitoring, and local escalation workflow.
The legacy page calls itself Manchester Triage System based without a governing citation or validation evidence; that claim is removed.
reviewer_decision: Pending independent emergency-clinician approval. Do not approve or publish this review draft.
